name: (1S)-1,25-Dihydroxy-24-Oxocalciol
notes: Vitamin D metabolite; secosteroid derived from cholesterol. Secosteroids are classified under steroids.

name: (25R)-3Beta-Hydroxy-5-Cholesten-26-Al
notes: Oxysterol; cholesterol derivative with aldehyde at C-26. CYP27A1 bile acid pathway intermediate.

name: Testosterone
notes: Classic androgen steroid hormone. No dispute.
SMILES shows 6-6-6-5 steroid core with sulfate ester. Steroid sulfate conjugate.

name: Calcidiol
notes: 25-hydroxyvitamin D3; secosteroid. Classified as steroid.

name: ent-isokaurene
notes: ent-Isokaurene is a C20 diterpene (labdane-related diterpenoid) NOT a steroid. Has 6-6-6-5 ring but is a tetracyclic diterpene from GGPP pathway.
SMILES shows seco-steroid (vitamin D-type) backbone with broken B-ring and triene system. Secosteroid.

name: Cortisone
notes: Classic glucocorticoid steroid hormone. No dispute.

name: dihydroniloticin
notes: Tirucallane-type triterpene (C30). CAS 115334-05-9. Not a steroid; triterpenes are terpenoids.

name: strychnine
notes: Terpene indole alkaloid from Strychnos. NOT a steroid despite complex polycyclic structure. Only Alkaloid is correct.

name: tetrahydroalstonine
notes: Monoterpene indole alkaloid (heteroyohimbine-type). NOT a steroid. Only Alkaloid is correct.

name: 6alpha-hydroxytyphasterol
notes: Brassinosteroid (plant steroid hormone). Typhasterol is a well-known BR intermediate. Steroid correct.

name: (1S,4S,5R,9S,10S,13S)-13-hydroxy-5,9-dimethyl-14-methylidene-...
notes: SMILES shows C20 kaurane-type skeleton with COOH. This is a diterpene acid, NOT a steroid.

name: 17Alpha-Hydroxypregnenolone
notes: Pregnane steroid; precursor in steroidogenesis. No dispute.

name: isomotiol
notes: Pentacyclic triterpene (fern-8-en-3beta-ol) from Strychnos potatorum. C30 compound. NOT a steroid.

name: (25R)-3-Oxocholest-4-En-26-Ol
notes: Cholestane skeleton with ketone at C-3 and hydroxyl at C-26. Steroid (oxysterol).

name: 13-desoxypaxilline
notes: Indole-diterpene (paspaline-derived). NOT a steroid. Alkaloid label acceptable (contains indole N). Terpenoid is primary class.

name: 22(S)-Hydroxy-5Alpha-Campestan-3-One
notes: Campestane steroid skeleton. Brassinosteroid pathway intermediate. Steroid correct.

name: kauralexin A1
notes: ent-Kaurane diterpenoid phytoalexin from maize. C20 diterpene NOT a steroid.
SMILES shows classic steroid ABCD ring system with multiple hydroxyl groups. Consistent with ecdysteroid/brassinosteroid.

name: 2alpha-hydroxyismotiol-19-one
notes: Derivative of isomotiol; pentacyclic triterpene. C30 skeleton. NOT a steroid.

name: 3Beta-Hydroxycholest-5-En-7-One
notes: Cholestane skeleton with 3beta-OH and 7-keto. Oxysterol. Steroid correct.

name: 3beta-hydroxy-5beta-cholestan-6-one
notes: Cholestane steroid with 3beta-OH and 6-keto. Steroid correct.
SMILES shows C20 kaurane/isokaurene-type diterpene skeleton (same scaffold as ent-isokaurene). NOT a steroid.

name: Dihydrosanguinarine
notes: Benzophenanthridine alkaloid (benzylisoquinoline class). NOT a steroid. Only Alkaloid is correct.

name: 16Alpha,17Alpha-Dihydroxypregnenolone
notes: Pregnane steroid with additional hydroxyl groups. Steroid correct.

name: Versicolorin B
notes: Aflatoxin biosynthesis intermediate (anthraquinone). Polyketide pathway product. NOT a steroid.
SMILES shows secosteroid (vitamin D-type) backbone. Secosteroid classification is correct.

name: Ursodeoxycholate
notes: Bile acid (secondary); steroidal structure derived from cholesterol. Steroid correct.

name: 3-O-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-isomotiol
notes: Glucoside of isomotiol (pentacyclic triterpene). NOT a steroid.

name: 6Alpha-Hydroxycastasterone
notes: Brassinosteroid (6alpha-hydroxy intermediate). Plant steroid hormone. Correct.

name: 3-O-(beta-D-glucopyranosyl)-2alpha-acetoxyisomotiol
notes: Acetylated glucoside of isomotiol. Pentacyclic triterpene derivative. NOT a steroid.

name: 26-Oxolanosterol
notes: Lanosterol derivative. Lanosterol is the precursor to all animal/fungal steroids. Sterol/steroid classification correct.

name: Castasterone
notes: Brassinosteroid (plant steroid hormone). The most widely distributed BR. Steroid correct.
SMILES shows fluorinated corticosteroid (9-fluoro pregnane skeleton). Synthetic steroid. Correct.

name: Ecdysone
notes: Insect molting steroid hormone (ecdysteroid). Steroid correct.

name: 27-Hydroxycholesterol
notes: Oxysterol; endogenous SERM. Cholesterol metabolite. Steroid correct.

name: (22S)-22-hydroxycampesterol
notes: Phytosterol; early brassinosteroid pathway intermediate. Steroid correct.
SMILES matches protoberberine isoquinoline alkaloid (coptisine-like). NOT a steroid. Only Alkaloid is correct.

name: 2alpha,19beta-dihydroxyisomotiol
notes: Hydroxylated isomotiol derivative. Pentacyclic triterpene. NOT a steroid.
